description_en: Retrieves the sales information of cloud service configuration check, including the number of authorized quotas and consumed quotas
description_zh: 获取云产品配置检查售卖信息，包括：授权数、已消耗授权数等
name: GetCheckSale

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Security Center instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China
ap-southeast-1: outside China
parameters.help_zh:
云安全中心实例地域。取值为：

cn-hangzhou：  中国
ap-southeast-1：  全球（不含中国）
parameters.name: region_id

CheckSale.description_en: The sales information of cloud service configuration check
CheckSale.description_zh: 云产品配置检查售卖信息

ConsumeCount.description_en: The number of consumed authorized quotas

LoyalUser.description_en:
Indicates whether the user is an existing user who used the cloud service configuration check feature before the sales feature was released (July 7, 2023). Valid values:
true: The user is an existing user.
false: The user is not an existing user
LoyalUser.description_zh:
是否为存量用户，售卖功能发布（2023年07月07日）之前，是否使用云产品配置检查功能的用户。取值：
true：存量用户
false：非存量用户

PurchaseCount.description_en: The number of purchased authorized quotas

SaleUserType.description_en:
The sales user type. Valid values:
1: Full-feature user. The user can use all check items.
2: Upgrade-required user. The user can use only the check items that were available before the sales feature was released (July 7, 2023).
3: Purchase-required user. The user cannot use the cloud service configuration check feature
SaleUserType.description_zh:
售卖用户类型。取值：
1：全功能用户，可以使用所有的检查项
2：需要升级用户，只能使用售卖功能发布（2023年07月07日）之前的检查项
3：需要购买用户，不能使用云产品配置检查功能
SaleUserType.title_en: 售卖用户类型：1=全功能用户，2=需要升级用户，3=需要购买用户
SaleUserType.title_zh: 售卖用户类型：1=全功能用户，2=需要升级用户，3=需要购买用户

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The China Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request, which can be used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
